worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.summary: Raise Defense and roll a short distance in the chosen direction when hit.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.use.0: Curl up when cornered and roll away from each hit to change position
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.use.1: With the roll set to charge in, use the impact to close the gap
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.use.2: Raise Defense with a cheap short window before trading
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.descriptio: Each hostile hit rolls you about %1$s blocks along the chosen direction.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.roll.away: Roll away: each hit rolls you away from the attacker, trading position and distance.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.roll.into: Charge in: each hit rolls you toward the attacker, staying inside its reach.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.growth.0: At level %1$s the curl lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.growth.1: At level %1$s the curl lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.defensecurl.preference: Roll away: each hit rolls you away from the attacker, trading position and distance. Charge in: each hit rolls you toward the attacker, staying inside its reach.
